steps.title: Stocks Leaderboard — Evidence Chips on Every Row
steps.narration: Every stock on the leaderboard now carries a small 'Not yet proven' chip below each of its three score badges — Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk. The chips are purely additive: scores, letter grades, and row order are completely untouched.
steps.point_out: The muted gray 'Not yet proven' chips appear below each score badge on every row across all 120 stocks in the leaderboard.

steps.title: Stock Detail — Score Cards with Evidence Chips
steps.narration: Drilling into any individual stock shows all three score cards — Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk — each now carrying a 'Not yet proven' chip directly beneath the numeric score. The existing score value, label, and description are fully preserved alongside the new chip.
steps.point_out: All three score cards display their numeric scores and letter grades exactly as before, with a 'Not yet proven' chip added below each score value — nothing has been removed or replaced.

steps.title: Evidence Nav Link — Reach the Ledger in One Click
steps.narration: A new 'Evidence' entry now lives in the left sidebar right after 'Research'. Clicking it takes you directly to the certified-claims ledger — the single source of truth for what has actually been proven about each signal.
steps.point_out: The 'Evidence' link with its shield-and-checkmark icon is visible in the sidebar without scrolling, and is active and highlighted once you land on the Evidence page.

steps.title: Evidence Page — Honest Empty State with Claim Field Preview
steps.narration: With no referee-certified claims entered yet, the page honestly declares 'No certified claims yet' and lists all five fields that every future certified claim must supply. Nothing is fabricated — every signal reads 'Not yet proven' until a real, out-of-sample, control-beating claim backs it.
steps.point_out: The empty state lists exactly five required fields — Hypothesis, Out-of-sample verdict, Control comparison (vs SPY), Registration date, and Forward-walk score-to-date — making the standard transparent from day one.
